design.curve_generation: Short Weierstrass y^2=x^3+a*x+b. Candidate zero is (a,b)=(1,1). Sample seven distinct other pairs uniformly with numpy default_rng seeded by SeedSequence([20260904,p,0]); reject 4*a^3+27*b^2=0 modulo p. Preserve every rejection and generation cost. No group-order or discrete-log computation.
design.auxiliary_generation: Four quadratic polynomials q=c20*x^2+c11*x*y+c02*y^2+c10*x+c01*y+c00. Independently sample each coefficient uniformly in 1..p-1 using SeedSequence([20260904,p,1]). Share the same four q across all eight curves at that p.
design.case_definition: One curve plus one q over its prime. The 24 context groups each contain eight candidate curves. Preserve zero-root cases and report timing/root-count strata; root count is not a pre-solve feature.
design.fixed_solver: SymPy groebner([y^2-x^3-a*x-b,q], x,y, modulus=p, order=lex), followed by bounded finite-field root extraction using the lex basis: enumerate y roots of its x-free polynomials, then enumerate/lift x and verify all original polynomials. Record any absence of an elimination polynomial; a bounded full-field fallback must be reported and timed.
design.independent_oracle: A separate verifier directly enumerates every (x,y) in F_p^2 using integer modular arithmetic and compares the complete sorted original-system root set with the solver result. Do not validate against the producer basis alone.

cost_measurement.primary_label: Median across repetitions of symbolic construction + Groebner basis + finite-field root extraction seconds.
separate_metrics: peak resident memory with units and method
full root count distribution and nonempty/empty strata
cost_measurement.ordering: Seeded shuffle of case order; preserve exact order. All three repetitions stay in one bounded child. No discarded slow observations.
cost_measurement.failure_handling: Any mismatch or missing/censored cost invalidates the full training/evaluation attempt; preserve partial observations and record failed_implementation/resource_exhaustion as appropriate. A timeout is not a mathematical result.

models.supervised: Ridge regression on log seconds, fixed alpha=1, standardization fitted on training primes only. Feature vector contains normalized a,b, discriminant, prime size and q coefficients plus fixed pairwise interactions. No timings, root counts, basis statistics or test-derived transforms as features.
models.rl: One-step softmax policy-gradient contextual bandit over eight curves per context, trained in an offline simulator backed by the measured training cost table. Label as contextual bandit, not multi-step RL. Fixed 1000 updates, learning rate 0.01, zero initial weights, running-average reward baseline, three declared fit seeds [0,1,2]. Reward is negative log measured seconds normalized using training labels only. No new solver calls during updates.
models.baseline_random: One uniformly sampled candidate per context using declared seeds [0,1,2]; additionally report exact expected random cost over the eight measured candidates.
models.evaluation: One selected curve per held-out context and method/seed with identical solver settings. Report actual measured selected cost, oracle-best cost as retrospective context, difference from random/static, and all overheads separately. Validation is diagnostic; no hyperparameter tuning or selection on test primes. Model checkpoint stores split IDs and normalization.

controls.positive: Separate synthetic two-action fixture with costs [8,1] and features [-1,+1] verifies cost direction and that a training update increases the cheaper action probability. These artificial labels are never mixed into measured costs.
controls.null_constant: Same-shaped contexts with equal candidate costs: policy utility equals the exact random expectation regardless of choice; reward-centering must not manufacture a gain.
controls.null_permutation: Seeded permutation of training labels within each training context, same features and evaluation code. Preserve result as a diagnostic; no demanded finite-sample null significance or performance threshold.
controls.correctness: Independent complete modular root enumeration for every case. Reject singular curves, out-of-list primes, duplicate split membership, arbitrary input polynomial imports, missing cases, incorrect costs, or leakage.
controls.acceptance: Software validity is independent of whether ML/RL beats random or static. A valid slower policy is a valid observation; no speedup, general-field or cryptographic conclusion is authorized.
